Profile

About Mansur

A journalist focused on ground-level reporting, regional developments and public-interest stories from North Bengal.

Mansur Habibullah is a journalist and ground reporter based in Cooch Behar, West Bengal. He works with Aaj Tak and the India Today Group, reporting on developments across North Bengal.

His reporting interests include regional politics, governance, India–Bangladesh border affairs, crime, environment, wildlife, child rights and human-interest stories. His work focuses on bringing local voices and ground realities to a wider audience.

He previously worked with Bartaman Patrika and has experience in digital journalism. He holds a Bachelor of Technology degree from the College of Engineering and Management, Kolaghat.
